title: On globally invariant Euler--Lagrange equations for curves
summary: Invariant Lagrangians yield invariant Euler-Lagrange equations, and it was discussed in the literature how to compute those using various local methods. The focus of this paper is on global algebraic differential invariants. In this case the computation can be modified in several aspects. We will discuss relations with previous approaches and some foundational aspects. The theory of invariant Euler-Lagrange equations was applied to curves with respect to the motion group in the Euclidean plane and space.
